machines.name: Source normalization, frontmatter and fenced Markdown scanner
machines.state_storage: Per-call string/line cursor, open fence character+length, parsed flat fields; no persisted workflow state

transitions.effects: Strip one leading BOM and convert CRLF to LF.
transitions.failure_retry: Other bytes preserved; parser alone does not normalize input.

transitions.guard: first line exactly --- and later closing exact ---
transitions.effects: Return flat frontmatter plus body after leading empty lines.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing/unclosed opener returns null frontmatter and whole original body, not a hard error.

transitions.effects: Split first colon, trim, strip one matching outer quote pair; last repeated key wins.
transitions.failure_retry: Blank/colonless lines ignored; nested YAML unsupported but not generally rejected by this flat parser.

transitions.effects: Remember character and opener length; mark delimiter fenced.
transitions.failure_retry: No semantic interpretation of code inside fence.

transitions.guard: same character,at least opener length,only whitespace after
transitions.effects: Mark closing line fenced, then resume headings.
transitions.failure_retry: Short/mixed/nonterminal closer stays inside; unclosed fence extends to EOF.

transitions.effects: Extract heading/level/index and optional trailing-hash trimming; demote1–5 only when requested.
transitions.failure_retry: Fenced headings ignored; level6 unchanged by demotion.

transitions.effects: Use supplied name; otherwise basename without .md, or parent for SKILL.
transitions.failure_retry: Callers can explicitly pass empty fields to enforce filename identity.

transitions.effects: Increment per-normalized-base counter and suffix repeated base -2,-3.
transitions.failure_retry: No global reserved-output set: generated suffix can equal a different natural base; no current production collision claimed.

transitions.effects: Return unique matched names then boolean availability per command.
transitions.failure_retry: Regex discovery is not live host registration proof.

transitions.effects: Claude falls back to collected command names; Codex/Pi empty availability.
transitions.failure_retry: Does not infer same availability across hosts.

transitions.guard: first level1 heading outside frontmatter/fences is bare lowercase skill identifier
transitions.effects: Resolve explicit owning skill convention.
transitions.failure_retry: /ca: heading or no matching identifier produces no claim; no guessed pairing from filename.

transitions.guard: every claimed skill exists; unique command owner per skill; catalog available
transitions.effects: Alias visibility retains skill page and pointer; other visibility merges skill into command page.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown/duplicate owner aggregated error; claim without catalog throws; no claims returns empty even if catalog absent.

transitions.guard: pair map and supplied historical old-slug set

transitions.effects: Group fixed command/skill/agent order, sort sidebar labels, nest command visibility and workflow groups.

transitions.effects: Return empty map for generated-only fallback.

transitions.guard: entity in collected source set and not seen before

findings.title: Prune nudge threshold describes total context instead of freed context
findings.description: Configuration table says CODEARBITER_PRUNE_NUDGE_MIN_TOKENS sets minimum model-context size. Current nudge_decision compares estimated tokens from rec.context_bytes_freed to threshold. No runtime behavior change is recommended for this documentation correction.
findings.recommendation: Describe freed avoidable context accurately and derive this predicate/default from an executable contract instead of maintaining a second semantic description.

findings.classification: confirmed extractor limitation and overbroad generated claim
findings.title: Hook reference is a bounded static extraction, not all actual runtime message text
findings.description: Generated intro says it can never drift from what a hook prints. scanMessage drops variable/helper message suffixes, variable tag resolution is limited to30 lines, and skipped calls are not extracted. Current _bashguardlib security blocks append dynamic recovery strings. Literal-tag pass also omits codeMask test, so quoted/commented examples can be extracted as real calls; this latter false-positive possibility is static, not a demonstrated current site occurrence.
findings.recommendation: Label static templates/omitted dynamic pieces and display extraction gaps; use a typed gate registry or robust AST extraction for canonical IDs/events/recovery while keeping actual runtime code authoritative.

findings.classification: static helper edge case, current production reachability not demonstrated
findings.title: Slug suffix counts do not reserve all output slugs
findings.description: assignSlugs tracks each base independently. The input sequence foo,foo,foo-2 produces foo,foo-2,foo-2 by direct control-flow inspection. Current installed-source names were not evaluated for such a collision in this supplemental read.
findings.recommendation: If arbitrary names remain supported, reserve emitted slugs globally and fail or consistently disambiguate collisions. Preserve previously published URL redirects when changing assignment.

coverage.note: Build-time/read-only/transient machines only in these helpers. Parent generator file owns filesystem publication and stale-output cleanup; do not count this as a second durable generation owner.
